Out/Doubtful/Questionable/IR excluded. Max 1 leg per team, 2 per game; legs priced +250 or shorter with est. chance ≥25%. 2+ TD markets skipped (too unlikely). TD legs are coin flips at best, so read each ticket's chance honestly.

nba3r.rule: Pregame only, FanDuel PA made-threes and rebounds (main and alt lines). One leg per player (his highest-chance line −1000 to +150), max 2 per game, each leg in at most 5 tickets, est. chance ≥60%, not more than 2 pts below FanDuel's no-vig and capped at 3 pts above it. Chance = 50% market (FanDuel no-vig, averaged with Pinnacle's line converted to this threshold when listed) + 50% ESPN game-log hit rate (this season + last 20 games of 2025-26 at 40% weight, shrunk), then: minutes trend, opponent 3PA / rebounds allowed and pace from their last ≤10 box scores (±3/±3/±2 pts), teammates out (+1), back-to-back (−2), then a calibration haircut (rebounds −6 pts; threes −3) because these have hit below estimate so far. Rebound unders are excluded (they hit about 50% so far). Out/Doubtful/Questionable/Day-To-Day excluded.
